description: Direttiva Alluvioni 2019 II Ciclo - Ambito Regione Emilia-Romagna is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Aggiornamento e revisione delle mappe di pericolosità e del rischio di alluvione redatte ai sensi dell'art. 6 del D. Lgs. 49/2010 attuativo della Dir. 2007/60/CE - II ciclo di gestione. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Floods Directive 2019 II Cycle - Area Emilia-Romagna Region" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
